custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active tracked part, part A, for this test with 7 on hand: 4 in one bin and 3 in another.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154772-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154772-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens with the switch on.

Step 2:

  • The switch turns off at once: no confirmation, warning or message appears, even though the part holds 7.

Step 3:

  • The window closes straight away and no confirmation window of any kind opens.
  • Part A's row reads "Not Tracked" in Total Qty.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part)

  • S5-R5: “Turning tracking off asks for no confirmation, whatever the part holds.”
  • S5-R1: “The "Track quantities and cost of goods" switch can be changed in the Edit Inventory Part dialog.”
  • Key Decisions: “Turning tracking off only hides the count. Nothing is cleared and nothing is written off, so there is nothing to confirm. Turning tracking back on shows the count as it stands. Clearing stock while the accounting kept moving it would count the same cost twice.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: board "5.2 Switch off". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above.

Design pictures attached to this case:

The design's own words:

  • “Min and Max are hidden in the part dialog, and no bin quantity changes (S5-R3). The bin and its quantity stay visible as a shelf reference (S5-R3a). There is no confirmation, whatever the part holds (S5-R5). The change applies on Save (S5-R2).”
